source.title: Generic product management documentation and quality standard
source.coveragePolicy: Every required component is merged into one owning field. The stage profile has seven unsampled mandatory semantic gates per item; detailed field/element/hierarchy rules remain reference or advisory samples and are not default per-rule review obligations.

dimensions.description: All required information is present and applicable unknowns are visible.
A reviewer can interpret the wording without guessing.
Actors, boundaries, states and referents identify one intended meaning.
Claims map to authoritative sources and canonical linked records.
Fields, sources, states and related levels agree.
No duplicated scope, competing canonical record or repeated acceptance count.
Expected outcomes can be verified with reproducible observations.
The work supports an identified user or operator outcome.
Existing constraints, dependencies and resources support the proposal.
Measures define population, method, period and thresholds without invention.
Authorization boundaries and harmful effects are constrained.
Personal information is minimized, scoped and supported by approved purpose.
Failures, recovery, ownership and operating environment are specified.
Identity, revision, freshness and change authority remain unambiguous.
Actual decision/approval/access authority is evidenced.
Evidence is authentic, bounded to the artifact version and not inferred.
Sequence and trade-offs reflect declared outcomes and constraints.
Uncertainty has a falsifiable research/decision plan.
Applicable interaction and device barriers have observable requirements.
One coherent bounded outcome; scope and hand-offs exclude unrelated bundled work and hidden expansion.

gatePolicy.qualityGoal: All seven applicable current-stage must-pass gates and mandatory automated integrity checks pass with current evidence; no averaging or time/iteration-based success. Advisory samples do not inflate this certification.
gatePolicy.stageAwareApplicability: Planning stage: require a bounded testable plan, sourced priority/dependency rationale and honestly attributed size uncertainty where relevant. Unagreed targets/owners/estimates may remain explicitly pending only before a dependent commitment, approval or ready decision; record the exact unresolved decision and evidence needed. Future execution/launch results remain planned, never fabricated. RequiredFieldIds are stage-specific; unknown necessary applicability, authority, protected obligations or evidence remain unresolved.
gatePolicy.protectedSourceObligations: Protected source/frozen requirements and applicable safety, security, privacy, access, domain and process-control obligations cannot be waived by generic N/A; any applicable change requires the actual authority and a versioned decision.
gatePolicy.questionLoop: Repair verified editorial gaps autonomously; ask bounded field/check-specific questions for unavailable facts or authority, apply supported answers, invalidate changed dependent results, rerun and review. A repeated no-progress state remains awaiting information/blocked rather than PASS.
gatePolicy.reviewEvidence: Each qualitative gate PASS requires a reasoned review, exact evidence locator and current fingerprint. Offline locally declared reviewers provide advisory assessment only; real authoritative review needs a separately administered externally verified reviewer registry.
gatePolicy.reviewLoad: Seven required gates per current-stage element, up to two advisory sample reviews per hierarchy level across all assessed items and mandatory automatic integrity checks. No component verdicts. Optional exhaustive review is explicitly priced and never the default.

reviewInterpretation: Seven unsampled stage-specific aggregate gates per instantiated element are the must-pass semantic contract. All automatic integrity checks remain mandatory. At most two deterministic noncritical field-rule targets per hierarchy level across all assessed items are advisory samples; passing them never attests unsampled detailed reference coverage. Every applicable gate requires reasoned current evidence. Real reviewer authority comes from an externally administered trust registry; offline mode is advisory only and cannot authenticate identities or authorize readiness/delivery.
detailQualityPolicy: Details are required content components merged into their owning field. They have stable component IDs and labels, not independent pass criteria, tests, verdicts or quality scores. Selected aggregate gates assess applicable components in the owning field with evidence; reference field rules remain available for advisory sampling or explicit exhaustive review.

controlled actions, authority and prohibited effects
declared qualification and delivery route with stage evidence

product AI use yes/no/unknown and separately declared authoring AI

productProfilePolicy.assessment: A standalone intake document is not automatically consumed. Map its verified actual statements into pinned sources, owning fields and engine model productProfile.ai/personalData. The engine evaluates explicit branch applicability and stage-required fields; current aggregate review verifies the substantive scope/evidence. Reference field rules are advisory samples by default or explicit exhaustive inspection.
productProfilePolicy.nonapplicability: An evidence-backed branch exclusion must reference actual pinned scope. Selected aggregate gates review factual field/component exclusions with justified current applicability; required/protected fields and active AI/personalData branch obligations cannot be exempted. Unknown necessary applicability or unavailable evidence is unresolved. Explicit exhaustive mode retains its per-rule applicability contract; absent mechanisms do not waive other applicable obligations.
productProfilePolicy.defaults: No assumed industry, named role, product count, release code, hosting route, identity architecture, mobile device, persistent store, synchronization feature, branch process or domain policy.
productProfilePolicy.compatibility: Canonical generic field IDs govern. compatibility-map.json maps legacy software-shaped field/check/component identifiers through explicit migration; content is preserved but changed catalogue/identity invalidates old reviews. A legacy passing report never survives migration as a current PASS.
productProfilePolicy.executableBranchContract: Engine input productProfile.ai and productProfile.personalData carry applicability yes/no/unknown, pinned sourceIds and specific rationale. Discovery unknown requires a sourced resolutionPlan with no consequential runtime evaluation; planning/ready/delivery/learning unknown remains needs_input. Actual pinned source objects may additionally assert requiredBranches={ai:true, personalData:true}; absent metadata is not an exclusion, false branch metadata is invalid, and a no/N/A profile cannot remove a required branch.

discovery.description: Discovery stage: qualify the problem, highest-risk assumption, evidence and next decision. Clearly label proposed metrics/estimates/controls as hypotheses and identify unresolved decisions; do not require future build, release or measured launch results. If a present discovery test is required by source or a commitment depends on it, inspect its actual evidence or keep that decision blocked.

planning.description: Planning stage: require a bounded testable plan, sourced priority/dependency rationale and honestly attributed size uncertainty where relevant. Unagreed targets/owners/estimates may remain explicitly pending only before a dependent commitment, approval or ready decision; record the exact unresolved decision and evidence needed. Future execution/launch results remain planned, never fabricated.

ready.description: Ready stage: the item can proceed through the declared actual process with the required scope/targets, feasible estimate/dependencies, evaluation access, controls and actual authority decisions resolved. Apply the canonical team Ready policy where linked. Quality PASS cannot grant approval: any independent human/business/legal/safety approval or access decision remains a separate prerequisite, and an unresolved required prerequisite blocks ready.

delivery.description: Delivery stage: inspect original final-revision evaluation outputs against frozen expected results, required current independent review and actual authorized delivery observations within item scope. Distinguish qualified, accepted, integrated/published, available and user-verified states; fail or retain precise blockers for missing/failed evidence. A software SHA/CI/hosting mechanism is required only if the actual product process uses it.

learning.description: Learning stage: after the agreed observation period compare actual outcomes with the original target/hypothesis under compatible metric/population definitions; retain uncertainty, counterevidence and unintended effects. Record a sourced continue/change/stop decision, actual owner, canonical strategy/roadmap feedback or explicit no-change rationale, and next measurement. A future/pending review does not claim completed learning.

review_profiles.sample_policy: At most two deterministic advisory field-rule checks per hierarchy level across all assessed items beyond the seven must-pass current-stage gates per item. Sample selection does not certify unsampled detailed reference rules. Explicit exhaustive mode is optional and its workload is displayed. All structural/evidence/source/version/trust integrity plus applicable critical assurance obligations remain unsampled.
